objective: Make the hardware-shell container's SROS2 and DDS environment actually match what ROS 2 Jazzy reads, and make the container doctor fail closed instead of passing a silently disabled security configuration.
decision_supported: The LAN hardware-shell profile may only claim SROS2 Enforce when the environment variables use the exact literals rcl compares against, and the doctor must reject a value that rcl silently ignores.
acceptance: ROS_SECURITY_ENABLE uses the exact literal 'true' that rcl_security_enabled compares against, because '1' is compared as false and silently disables security.
The container doctor rejects ROS_SECURITY_ENABLE values that rcl treats as disabled, so a broken security profile reports NOT_EXECUTED instead of PASS.
The dead ROS_SECURITY_ROOT_DIRECTORY variable is removed because no component in ROS 2 Jazzy reads it; ROS_SECURITY_KEYSTORE remains the single keystore setting.
Participant discovery uses ROS_AUTOMATIC_DISCOVERY_RANGE instead of the deprecated ROS_LOCALHOST_ONLY, preserving the same localhost-only and LAN discovery behavior.
Unit tests fail if the non-matching SROS2 enable literal, the dead root-directory variable, or the deprecated discovery variable returns to the profile.
Documentation records the exact rcl literal requirement and the discovery-range variables an operator must set for LAN operation.
evidence: Focused container-profile test output and Ruff check/format output
Recorded rcl source reference showing ROS_SECURITY_ENABLE is compared against the literal 'true'
Recorded local ROS 2 Jazzy probe output separating the enabled and silently disabled literals
Recorded local probe output showing the generated Fast DDS interface whitelist restricts discovery to the selected interface
required repository test, contract, scenario and context checks
stop_conditions: A public interface/schema, firmware, robot-control or service change is required.
The fix would require claiming real-network two-host DDS, discovery-server or physical keystore validation that was not executed.
A change is needed outside the allowed paths or would require an unapproved owner decision.
Removing the deprecated variable would silently change discovery behavior rather than preserve it.
data_classification: container runtime environment configuration and SROS2 policy settings; no credentials or private keys
model_policy: No model output is admitted as SROS2 policy, DDS discovery authority or physical network evidence.
risks_and_fallbacks: Dual-physical-host DDS, wrong-NIC, cross-domain isolation and discovery-server behavior remain NOT_EXECUTED until validated on a real network.
